/-- **Large `q`**: for `q ≥ 2.2·10¹⁰` and `1 ≤ R < λ(q)`, `log q + 1.039 R ≤ 1.03 (qR)^{2/9}`. -/
theorem large_q_hS {q : ℕ} (hq : 22000000000 ≤ q) {R : ℝ} (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hR : R < lamQ q) :
    Real.log q + 1.039 * R ≤ 1.03 * ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
  have hq' : (22000000000 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by linarith
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hlam := lamQ_pow_le hq
  have hR7 : R ^ 7 ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ hR0.le hR.le 7).trans hlam
  -- `R^{7/9} ≤ (103/120) q^{2/9}`
  have h79 : R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hR7 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 9)
    have eL : (R ^ 7) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) = R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hR0.le]; norm_num
    have eR : ((103 / 120 : ℝ) ^ 9 * (q : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) =
        (103 / 120 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity), ← Real.rpow_natCast,
        ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num), ← Real.rpow_natCast (q : ℝ), ← Real.rpow_mul hq0.le]
      norm_num
    rwa [eL, eR] at h
  have hsplit : R = R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hR0]; norm_num
  have hqR : ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) = (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) :=
    Real.mul_rpow hq0.le hR0.le
  have hRle : R ≤ (103 / 120 : ℝ) * ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
    rw [hqR]
    calc R = R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * R ^ ((7 : ℝ) / 9) := hsplit
      _ ≤ R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) * ((103 / 120 : ℝ) * (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h79 (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hlog := log_le_rpow29 hq'
  have hR29 : 1 ≤ R ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := Real.one_le_rpow hR1 (by norm_num)
  have hq29 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by positivity
  have hlog' : Real.log q ≤ 0.13819 * ((q : ℝ) * R) ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 9) := by
    rw [hqR]; nlinarith
  nlinarith

theorem regionL {Q Q₀ : ℝ} (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hρ : Real.log Q₀ ≤ 0.6 * Real.log Q) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q)) (hlam : lamQ q ≤ Q₀ / (s * q)) :
    Gq q (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ (Real.log Q₀ + 1.36) / (Real.log Q + cE) * Gq q (Q / (s * q)) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hram⟩ := ramare_Gq
  refine star_suffices hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hc1 hc2 ?_
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hsq : 0 < s * q := by positivity
  set R := Q₀ / (s * q)
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
  set K := (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q
  have hK := qphi_pos hq
  have hf := f1q_pos q
  have hκ := kapQ_pos hq
  have he1 := (abs_le.1 (hram q hq R hR)).2
  have he2 := e2_bound hq hQ hs hR hram
  -- `K · 7.4527 f₁ R^{−1/3} ≤ κ(q)`
  set X := K * 7.4527 * f1q q / kapQ q
  have hX0 : 0 < X := by positivity
  have hXR : X ≤ R ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (X ^ 3) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ R ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hlam (by norm_num)
    rwa [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hX0.le, show ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 3) = 1 by norm_num,
      Real.rpow_one] at h1
  have hR3 : 0 < R ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hRneg : R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) = 1 / R ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hR0.le, inv_eq_one_div]
  have hmain : K * 7.4527 * f1q q * R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) ≤ kapQ q := by
    rw [hRneg, mul_one_div, div_le_iff₀ hR3]
    have : K * 7.4527 * f1q q = X * kapQ q := by simp only [X]; field_simp
    rw [this]; nlinarith
  have hloga : Real.log q ≤ Real.log (s * q) := Real.log_le_log hq0 (by nlinarith)
  have hRp : 0 ≤ R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) := by positivity
  calc K * ((Gq q R - (Nat.totient q / q) * (Real.log R + c + Sq q)) +
        0.6274 * max 0 (-(Gq q (Q / (s * q)) -
          (Nat.totient q / q) * (Real.log (Q / (s * q)) + c + Sq q))))
      ≤ K * (7.284 * R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) * f1q q +
          0.6274 * (7.284 * 0.03685 * R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) * f1q q)) := by gcongr
    _ ≤ K * 7.4527 * f1q q * R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
        have : 0 ≤ K * f1q q * R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) := by positivity
        nlinarith
    _ ≤ kapQ q := hmain
    _ ≤ _ := by unfold kapQ; nlinarith
